# The marker that counts

The first top-level marker is the placement site. Every other marker in this
document is a misuse, and each must be reported and removed without leaving
an element behind. One term is marked here: [delta]{.index}.

::: {.qi-index-here}
:::

# The misused ones

A marker below the top level places nothing — a `\printindex` inside a group
or environment is a render risk — so this one is only reported and removed:

::: {.callout-note}
Text around a nested marker, which must survive it.

::: {.qi-index-here}
:::
:::

A second top-level marker is reported by its position and removed; the index
stays at the first. One more term is marked here: [epsilon]{.index}. This one
also carries content, which is a misuse of its own — the marker is documented
as empty — and which must survive where the marker was written rather than be
deleted with it.

::: {.qi-index-here}
Content written inside a marker, which no misuse may delete.
:::
